jevRouting.code:
```
from typing import Annotated, Literal
from kedi.typesafe import (
    BooleanCriteria, ChoiceCriteria, Probability, Rubric,
)

Queue = Annotated[
    Literal["billing", "technical"],
    ChoiceCriteria({
        "billing": "Payments, refunds, and invoices",
        "technical": "Broken software or access",
    }),
]
Urgency = Annotated[
    float,
    Rubric(["Routine", "Time-sensitive", "Blocked now"]),
]
Churn = Annotated[
    Probability,
    BooleanCriteria(
        true="The customer intends to cancel their subscription",
        false="The customer plans to stay or has no cancellation intent",
    ),
]
```

> adapter: pydantic
> model: typesafe/jev-latest

~Triage(
  queue: `Queue`,
  urgency: `Urgency`,
  churn: `Churn`
)

[ticket] = I was charged twice. Reverse it or I cancel today.
>> Route and assess <ticket>: [triage: Triage].

[route] = `f"{triage.queue}/standard"`
> if: `triage.urgency >= 1.5 or triage.churn >= 0.8`:
  [route] := `f"{triage.queue}/priority"`

= <route>
